_source: Hover cards for the NET panel (Hud.net_help). Short paraphrases of CPR core p.197-207 as distilled in docs/rules/cyber-net.md sections 3.2-3.7; hand-edited. Each entry: name, cost, text (what it does), key (its numbers), page. Ids are Encounter.NET_ACTIONS (plus jack_out_unsafe and fire_turret), Combatant.programs, and the NET Actions header (net_actions).

net_actions.name: NET Actions
net_actions.text: A turn is either one Meat Action or your NET Actions, never both. Your Move Action stays yours either way. Moving between nodes is free.

backdoor.name: Backdoor
backdoor.text: Break the Password that bars the way (a firewall here). Knowing the password gets you through without a roll.

control.name: Control
control.text: Take a Control Node and what hangs off it: cameras, turrets, door locks. While you hold it, working each device costs a NET Action, from anywhere in the NET, once a turn per node. Jacking out drops every node you hold.

eye_dee.name: Eye-Dee
eye_dee.text: Identify a File and what it is worth. On a data gig, identifying the target File gets the job done.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.text: Map the Architecture as far as your Check reaches, stopping at the first obstruction whose DV beats it. Shows what is there, not the DVs.

zap.name: Zap
zap.text: Every Netrunner's built-in attack, here on the Black ICE in front of you. At 0 REZ the ICE is derezzed.
zap.key: Interface + 1d10 vs ICE DEF + 1d10 · hit: 1d6 REZ

slide.name: Slide
slide.text: Get away from one Black ICE: on a success you move to a neighbouring node and it stays where you left it. Once a turn, and only once it has found you.
slide.key: Interface + 1d10 vs ICE PER + 1d10 · -2 per Skunk

cross.name: Cross Socket
cross.text: Step through the socket into the linked site's NET. Progress in each NET is kept. Linked sites are this game's take on reaching another Architecture, not a book Ability.
cross.key: no roll · its Black ICE may be waiting

jack_out.name: Jack Out
jack_out.text: Leave the NET safely. Your Programs leave with you; held Control Nodes are lost. A Kraken's grip blocks it until its next turn.

jack_out_unsafe.name: Unsafe Jack Out
jack_out_unsafe.text: Pull the plug, Kraken or not. Every Black ICE you have met and not derezzed gets its attack on the way out.
jack_out_unsafe.key: each ICE met: its ATK + 1d10 vs your Interface + 1d10

fire_turret.name: Fire Turret
fire_turret.text: Work a turret on a Control Node you hold: it shoots with your own aim. Each node can act once a turn.
fire_turret.key: your REF + the weapon's Skill + 1d10 vs the range DV

sword.name: Sword
sword.text: Anti-Program Attacker: cuts Black ICE apart. It deactivates after the attack.
sword.key: ATK 1 · DEF 0 · REZ 0 · Interface + 1 + 1d10 vs ICE DEF + 1d10 · hit: 3d6 REZ to Black ICE (2d6 to other Programs)

armor.name: Armor
armor.text: Defender: lowers the brain damage you take while it is Rezzed. One copy running at a time, each copy once per Netrun.
